item.description: ### Added - **Sessions show their own name.** A Claude Desktop conversation now appears under the title you gave it — or the one Claude wrote for it — instead of just the folder it runs in. Two sessions in the same project are finally told apart. Cursor, OpenCode, Amp and Devin sessions gained the same thing: they were already carrying a title that Perch never showed. - **Cursor credit balance.** If your Cursor account has credit on it, the amount left now sits beside your usage bars, the same way it does for the other providers.
